items.question: I have hands but I can’t clap. What am I?
What has to be broken before you can use it?
I’m tall when I’m young and short when I’m old. What am I?
What has lots of teeth but never bites?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
What has a neck but no head?
What goes up but never comes down?
I have keys but open no doors. I have space but no room. You can enter, but you can’t go inside. What am I?
What can you catch but never throw?
What has one eye but can’t see?
What runs all day but never gets tired, and has a bed but never sleeps?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
What has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish?
What is full of holes but still holds water?
What word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?
What can travel all around the world while staying in one corner?
I’m light as a feather, yet the strongest person can’t hold me for more than a few minutes. What am I?
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
A girl has as many brothers as sisters, but each brother has only half as many brothers as sisters. How many brothers and sisters are in the family?
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
If you have me, you want to share me. If you share me, you don’t have me. What am I?
Forward I’m heavy, but backward I’m not. What am I?
What has a head and a tail but no body?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?
You see a boat full of people, yet there isn’t a single person on board. How?
What month of the year has 28 days?
What starts with T, ends with T, and has T in it?
Which weighs more: a kilogram of feathers or a kilogram of bricks?
items.answer: Neither — they both weigh a kilogram

items.question: What has many keys but can’t open a single lock, and makes music when you press them?
I am an odd number. Take away one letter and I become even. What number am I?
items.answer: Seven (take away the S and you get “even”)

items.question: What disappears as soon as you say its name?
